claims.text: The Fund’s primary investment objective is to generate current income while maintaining downside protection.
claims.quote: Our primary investment objective is to generate current income, while maintaining downside protection.

claims.text: The Fund pursues that objective by making first‑lien senior secured loans to U.S. middle‑market companies.
claims.quote: We seek to pursue our investment objective by investing primarily in a portfolio of newly originated, privately negotiated first‑lien senior secured loans to U.S. middle market companies.

claims.text: The Fund is organized as a perpetual‑life business development company whose shares are not listed on any exchange.

claims.text: The Fund intends to begin a discretionary quarterly share‑repurchase program no later than the quarter ending June 30 2027, with a target of repurchasing up to five percent of outstanding shares each quarter.
claims.quote: Beginning no later than the quarter ending June 30, 2027, we intend to commence a discretionary share repurchase program pursuant to which we intend to offer to repurchase, at the discretion of our Board of Directors, up to 5% of our Common Shares outstanding in each quarter.

claims.text: When shares are repurchased, the price will equal the NAV per share on the last calendar day of the designated month, subject to a deduction for shares held less than one year.

claims.text: The Fund asserts that a disciplined, credit‑driven approach focused on seniority, collateral support and lender‑oriented documentation is intended to mitigate downside risk.
claims.quote: Though no assurance can be given that the Fund will achieve its investment objective, we believe that a disciplined, credit‑driven approach focused on seniority in the capital structure, collateral support and lender‑oriented documentation can help mitigate downside risk across market environments.

judgment: The filing contains several forward‑looking statements that express management’s belief or expectation (e.g., that the perpetual‑life structure will enable a patient strategy, that a disciplined credit approach will mitigate downside risk, that competitors may have advantages). These are presented by the Company as opinion rather than objective fact.
gaps: No historical NAV or per‑share pricing data are disclosed, preventing any trend analysis of share value.
Earnings, cash‑flow or profitability metrics are not provided, so quantitative performance assessment is impossible.
The composition, size and credit quality of the current loan portfolio are not described, limiting evaluation of credit risk.
There is no disclosed timeline, criteria, or probability for a future liquidity event beyond the discretionary share‑repurchase program, leaving uncertainty about exit options for investors.
